description_en: Creates a real-time transcoding template for submitting real-time transcoding tasks
description_zh: 调用本接口创建实时转码模板，便于提交实时转码任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-live-transcode-template --type normal --name my_template --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveTranscodeTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The template type. Valid values:

normal: standard.
narrow-band: narrowband HD.
audio-only: audio only.
origin: original quality
parameters.help_zh:
模版类型。
normal - 普通
narrow-band - 窄高
audio-only - 纯音频
origin - 原画
parameters.name: type

fields.help_en: The bitrate of the transcoded audio. Unit: kbps. Valid values: 1 to 1000
fields.help_zh: 转码音频比特率。单位：kbps，取值：1~1000
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en:
The number of audio channels. Valid values:

1: mono.

2: stereo
fields.help_zh:
音频声道数。取值

1：单声道。

2：双声道
fields.name: channels

fields.help_en:
The audio encoding format. Valid values:

AAC
MP3
fields.help_zh:
音频编码格式。取值：

AAC
MP3
fields.name: codec

fields.help_en:
The audio encoding preset. When Codec is set to AAC, valid values:
aac_low
aac_he
aac_he_v2
aac_ld
fields.help_zh:
音频编码预置。当Codec为AAC时，取值：
aac_low
aac_he
aac_he_v2
aac_ld
fields.name: profile

fields.help_en:
The audio sample rate. Valid values: 22050 to 96000.

<notice>If AudioProfile is set to aac_ld, the sample rate must not exceed 44100.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
音频采样率。取值：22050~96000。

<notice>如果AudioProfile取值为aac_ld，则采样率不能超过44100。></notice>
fields.name: samplerate

fields.help_en: The bitrate of the transcoded video. Unit: kbps. Valid values: 1 to 6000
fields.help_zh: 转码视频比特率。单位：kbps，取值：1~6000
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en:
The encoding type. Valid values:

H.264
H.265
fields.help_zh:
编码类型。可选值：

H.264
H.265
fields.name: codec

fields.help_en: The frame rate of the transcoded video. Unit: FPS. Valid values: 1 to 60
fields.help_zh: 转码视频帧率。单位：FPS，取值：1~60
fields.name: fps

fields.help_en: The video GOP (Group of Pictures). Unit: frames. Valid values: 1 to 3000
fields.help_zh: 视频GOP（Group of Picture）。单位：帧，取值：1~3000
fields.name: gop

fields.help_en:
The height of the transcoded video. Valid values:

Height ≥ 128

max(Height, Width) ≤ 2560

min(Height, Width) ≤ 1440

<notice>For H.265 narrowband HD templates, the resolution must not exceed 1280 × 720.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
转码视频高度。取值：

Height ≥ 128

max（Height,Width）≤ 2560

min（Height,Width）≤ 1440

<notice>265窄带高清模板不得超过1280×720。></notice>
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The encoding profile. A set of specific encoding features supported by the video. A higher value generally produces better image quality but consumes more encoding and decoding resources. Valid values:

1: baseline (suitable for mobile devices).

2: main (suitable for standard resolution devices).

3: high (suitable for high resolution devices)
fields.help_zh:
编码级别。视频支持的一组特定的编码功能，一般值越大得到的画面质量越好，同时编解码消耗的资源也越高。取值：

1：baseline（适合移动设备）。

2：main（适合标准分辨率设备）。

3：high（适合高分辨率设备）
fields.name: profile

fields.help_en:
The width of the transcoded video. Valid values:

Width ≥ 128

max(Height, Width) ≤ 2560

min(Height, Width) ≤ 1440

<notice>For H.265 narrowband HD templates, the resolution must not exceed 1280 × 720.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
转码视频宽度。取值：

Width ≥ 128

max（Height,Width）≤ 2560

min（Height,Width）≤ 1440

<notice>265窄带高清模板不得超过1280×720。></notice>
fields.name: width

parameters.help_en:
The template configuration.
The pass parameter requirements vary based on the templatetype (Type). When Type is set to normal, at least one of the width and height parameters must be specified, and the frame rate and bitrate parameters are required. For other template types, specify the parameters based on your requirements
parameters.help_zh:
模版配置。
针对不同的模板类型（Type）的传参要求，参数填写规则如下：当Type的值为normal时，宽和高参数中至少需要填写一个，同时帧率和码率参数为必填项；对于其他类型的模板，需根据具体需求填写相应的参数
parameters.name: template_config
